notes: No injection found (integrity scan: one soft-hyphen only). Figures unavailable, so Fig. 4 claims were judged unverifiable; I initially inferred small ablation margins from extracted axis ticks and withdrew that in Phase 1.6. The skill never says what to do with a result the search labels 'prior (peer-reviewed)' whose venue evidence is dated after the cutoff (ICAM: T-ITS 2026), so I treated it as prior by its arXiv date. related_search.py novelty returns 'high' for claims with no match, while the domain agent says to cap at medium; I capped by hand. Hyphenated words like 'real-world' count as two words in the 4-word query limit. The skill's Bash steps (aggregate, related_search) work but the 'venue label' for final 3 on ICLR prints '4 on {0,2,4,6,8,10}', which reads oddly next to internal Overall 3. Paper-type choice (empirical vs dataset) for a dual dataset+method paper is not covered by the Field Analyst. The skill asks reviewers to run sequentially in one context while also requiring independence, so the DA and R1 share the protocol sweep and overlap heavily (CONSENSUS-4 items were mostly one issue). Phase order (reports first, then literature check) was followed, but reports could not use literature results, so R2's novelty reading relied on the paper's own related work plus knowledge until the addendum. The Bash tool needed approval for file redirection, so review.md was assembled by rewriting rather than concatenating parts; part1.md and part2.md are placeholder leftovers.
